scope: synthetic engineering only; no real market rows, account binding, or publication

rules.cutoff: declared in AdvicePolicy before produce; never inferred from member times
rules.per_member_clock: each member needs a concrete consumer-visible available_at <= decision_cutoff
rules.required_missing: INPUT_NOT_READY; no formal package is emitted
rules.empty_advice: only when all required members are admitted and no candidate was injected
rules.published_at: injected real publish instant; never backfilled; must not precede cutoff
rules.append_only: same market_date with different content refused; same (id,version) refused; receipt time must equal decision_set published_at
rules.blocked_reason: input_blocked carries only STALE_MARKET_INPUT or INPUT_UNAVAILABLE (P12 validate_decision_set)
rules.publishable: false when any decision is input_blocked
rules.evaluation_receipt: required on all paths; binding_digest covers batch+policy+cutoff+full candidate payload incl. security_name/industry_id/invalidations/next_observation; completed_at between intake_verified_at and cutoff; evaluated_count>0; qualified_count equals entry_plan count
rules.candidate_evidence: expert/risk digests must equal batch+policy+rule+opportunity bound digests; unknown reason code or mismatch -> input_blocked
rules.intake_clock: intake_received_at and intake_verified_at must be <= decision_cutoff
rules.p12_precheck: cutoff on market_date; published_at >= cutoff; next_session > market_date; unique ids and live security codes; entry window on next_session; no duplicate market_date in one package
rules.digest_surfaces: file_sha256 = on-disk bytes; decision_set_digests = canonical JSON; p12_package_digests = P12 account ConfigurationBinding digest digest(_package_content(validated)); p12_wire_digests = loader raw-wire-byte digest
rules.explanation_contract: Decision enforces registered reason, registered EXPLANATION_CODES code, valid use and non-empty component_ref on all stages; producer blocks invalid explanations before build; ProductDailyError during build becomes fail-closed
rules.entry_window: eligible/expires converted to Asia/Shanghai then inside 09:30-15:00 on next_session; expires_at>eligible_at; checked in EntryPlan, AdvicePolicy and DecisionSet
rules.publish_blocked: any input_blocked decision refuses write; p12_loader digests all decision_sets before write so a loader failure leaves no file; PublishReceipt carries p12_package_digests when loader supplied
rules.structural_gate: receipt/evidence checks are structural only; they grant no real upstream qualification
rules.limitations: P12 worktree path is an environment-conditional integration dependency; the producer validates the P12 shape but does not own P12 raw reason schema
